Targeted edge/contract checks: multipart edge cases, start-after pagination, anonymous HEAD, UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD — reproducing hard-to-fake signing/error details.
Code edits followed immediately by re-tests of the affected behavior, showing verification used to gate fixes and catch regressions.
Full regression run plus explicit audit-log format validation near the end — a repeatable harness re-exercised before finishing.
Console verified only via 'Console API tests' (JSON endpoints); no browser/DOM/testid-driven side-effect verification, the missing half of the grader loop.

reasoning: The agent built a broad, repeatable boto3-driven harness covering header+query signing, UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD, multipart/versioning edges, pagination, cross-tenant/anonymous behavior, a concurrency load test, and audit-log format — and re-ran tests to gate fixes, matching much of the level-8 anchor for the correctness grader. However, the console was verified only at the API level, not driven through the DOM/testids as the browser grader requires, so it falls short of the full level-8 (and 10) description. This places it at 7: clearly above the level-5 'core ops + some error codes' band, but missing the browser/UX side of the dual-grader loop.
